text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before heading out to race in the Satsuki 
Sho, the first leg of the Classic Triple 
Crown. Fuji Kiseki receives a phone call.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was a cheer from her underclassmen in 
the dorms. With that pleasant surprise in 
her heart, she took on the race.
